overview_description.description: Primer is a financial technology company that provides payment infrastructure designed to help businesses manage and optimize payment operations through a single platform. The company enables merchants to connect with multiple payment service providers, fraud prevention tools, digital wallets, and other commerce-related services without building separate integrations for each one. Its platform includes tools for payment routing, transaction monitoring, reconciliation, and workflow automation, allowing businesses to manage different stages of the payment lifecycle in one system. Primer also supports international payment operations by helping companies handle multiple currencies, regional payment methods, and provider integrations across markets. The company works with businesses in industries such as retail, travel, fintech, marketplaces, and digital services to simplify the management of complex payment ecosystems.
